report_title: Annual Report on Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (incl. 2024 MD&A)
data_status: historical - last standalone annual report; EMX merged into Elemental Altus Royalty Corp. (ELE) in November 2025 and was delisted; portfolio now reported under ELE
notes: Royalty & royalty-generation company (historical record). FY2024: revenue and other income US$27.448M; adjusted royalty revenue US$33.067M (2023: US$30.1M incl. $4.783M Timok catch-up for 2021-2022); 13,897 GEOs sold (2024 guidance: 11,000-14,000 GEOs). Three material royalties: Caserones, Timok, Gediktepe; Leeville, Balya and Gold Bar South also important to current and projected cash flow. Royalty portfolio totals 247 projects on six continents; Appendix A of the 2024 MD&A itemizes 7 producing, 10 advanced and 124 exploration royalties below (141 interests). Per-asset gold/silver ounces and reserves are not disclosed by the operator/EMX; revenue is the disclosed attributable figure. EMX completed its business combination with Elemental Altus Royalty in Nov 2025; see ELE for the combined portfolio.

mines.mine_notes: Operator: Lumina Copper / Lundin Mining. Interest: 0.8306% NSR. Commodity group: Copper; commodity: Copper-Molybdenum. Effective 0.8306% NSR (increased from 0.7775% via Q1 2024 acquisition of 0.0531% for $4.742M from Franco-Nevada). 2024 mine production: 124,761t Cu, 3,183t Mo. Payments received net of Chilean taxes: $6.772M for 2024. FY2024 royalty revenue: US$9,263,000.

Operator: Zijin Mining. Interest: 0.3625% NSR. Commodity group: Copper; commodity: Copper-Gold. Timok – Cukaru Peki per MD&A; 0.3625% NSR uncapped, cannot be repurchased or reduced; covers Upper and Lower Zones. 2023 revenue included $4.783M catch-up payments for 2021-2022. FY2024 royalty revenue: US$5,216,000.

Operator: Lidya Madencilik. Interest: 10% NSR Oxide / 2% NSR Sulfide. Commodity group: Precious Metals; commodity: Gold-Silver / Copper-Zinc-Gold- Silver. Perpetual 10% NSR on oxide zone (after 10koz cumulative GEO) and 2% NSR on sulfide zone (after 25koz cumulative GEO). Operator acquired by ACG Metals (LON:ACG) Sep 2024; sulfide expansion funded via $200M bond. FY2024 royalty revenue: US$11,954,000.
Operator: Esan. Interest: 4% NSR & other payments. Commodity group: Polymetallic; commodity: Zinc-Lead-Silver. FY2024 royalty revenue: US$1,141,000.

Operator: Bahar Madencilik. Interest: 3.5-5% NSR & other payments. Commodity group: Precious Metals; commodity: Gold (Copper). 3.5% NSR on-site / 5% NSR off-site. Initial gold production in 2024 (10,844 oz Au, 11,388 oz Ag sold Sep-Dec). EMX credited $981,000 in 2024, 80% applied to advance royalty repayment; $196,000 recorded as royalty revenue. FY2024 royalty revenue: US$196,000.
Operator: McEwen Mining Inc. Interest: 1% NSR. Commodity group: Precious Metals; commodity: Gold. FY2024 royalty revenue: US$475,000.

Operator: Nevada Gold Mines. Interest: 1% GSR.
